newsitem.title: USA: Peoples Telephone names chief oper officer.
newsitem.headline: Peoples Telephone names chief oper officer.

text.p: Peoples Telephone Co Inc said on Monday Neil Snyder III has been named to the post of executive vice president and chief operating officer of the company.
Snyder recently retired as a Brigadier General in the U.S. Army and most recently served as a senior staff officer at the U.S. Army Training and Doctrine Command in Hampton, Va., the company.
Richard Militello, the company's previous chief operating officer and executive vice president, he left the company in April 1996, a Peoples Telephone spokeswoman said.
